note: Both sets correctly capture the Cooking thresholds (full points ≥80 oz/2300 g, reduced 16–80 oz, no points ≤16 oz/450 g) and the 96.00 oz (2.721 kg) starting-water minimum, and both repeat many of these facts redundantly. Set A additionally covers the Dinner Party facts (two parties per team, 0–100% score range), which Set B omits entirely, so A has better coverage of the page. Set B invents a '100 points per cooking task' value not stated anywhere and asserts 0 points for vaporized weight < 80 oz, which contradicts the figure, plus it splices quotes ('5.000 lb vaporized', 'the starting water weight sha'). Set A's errors are mainly quote problems (caption used as support for the 0-point rule, a garbled 'sh[all be]' quote) and one misbinding of the 0–100% range to the final score rather than the percentage integer scores.
